SCOPE AND DETAILS OF WORK Supply, installation, configuration, system integration and testing of Local area network in FTR HQ BSF JALANDHAR campus and its buildings as per detail s in the Schedule of Requirements. 1. Optical Fibre Cable Laying i. Cables shall be ducted in HDPE pipes and laid in underground trenches which sha ll be at least 3 feet deep, or through trenchless digging by HDD machine wherever feas ible. ii. Cable laying below road ducts shall be in HDPE pipes / GI pipes. iii. Sealing of the ends of HDPE pipe should be done by HDPE end cap s of suitable size. iv. Back filling and dressing of the excavated trenches, should be don e with extracted material from the trench after removing coarse and h ard stony material that may damage piping or cable. v. Termination of OFC on Fibre Patch Panels shall be with Pigtail Conn ectors. vi. Fibre Patch Cords of the suitable type should be used to connect t he fibre patch panel with the network/ fibre switch. vii. All work on campus roads shall be taken up after necessary safety precautions, barricading and warning signs, and roads shall be restore d for public use. All materials and manpower required for the work shall be arranged by the contractor concerned prior information bef ore digging in a particular area is to be informed so that the st akeholders can be informed to make necessary direction.

viii. Trenching shall be done prior to laying of pipes as far as possible. C ontractor shall exercise due care that the soil from trenching intended for back filling is not mixed with loose hard debris. ix. While trenching, the contractor should take care not to damage an y underground installations belonging to other sections like electricity, telephone, water, etc. Any damage caused to these installations shall be restored by contractor at his own cost and expense. x. The trench must be made in such a way that HDPE pipe(s) shall be laid in a straight line except at locations where it has to necessarily ta ke a bend because of change in the alignment or gradient of the trenc h. Minimum bend radius considerations shall be dealt with appropriate ly. xi. OFC should not be exposed anywhere. In building premises and sh eds within workshop area, the laying of OFC to racks shall be done at a ppropriate height using HDPE pipes and should be clamped/ tied along walls/pillars/cable trays etc as per site condition/requirement. xii. OFC bend radius should be as per the norms. xiii. Markers will be placed at appropriate location to indicate the prese nce of underground fibre/cables 2. UTP/STP Cable Laying: I. Structured cabling standards shall be strictly followed. II. Cable should be laid within PVC Conduit/Casing & capping. III. Laying of PVC conduits/Casing & capping is to be done neatly. Scre ws, clamps, fillers etc. have to be arranged by the contractor and to be attached at every 3-4 feet. IV. Cat 6 UTP cable installation: Cat 6 UTP cables should be installed inside PVC conduit/casing & capping so that it is not exposed anywher e. V. Information Outlet Box installation: Complete IO box assemblie s shall be installed. VI. Racks installation: Wall mount network racks with necessary acce ssories like cable managers, patch panels, fans, power strips etc. shall be installed at the pre decided locations VII. UTP cable termination: Standards based termination of UTP cable s at both ends i.e. at patch panel and at RJ45 jacks of IO. III. Bend radius of the cable including the termination area shall not be l ess than 20 times the outside diameter of the cable. IV. Cables shall be neatly clamped on the walls near the termination bo xes or shelves in the racks. V. Each cable shall be clearly labelled at the enclosure end. The labels of cables within the shelf or wall mount enclosures should be visible. VI. Additional OFC of at least 5 meters of length should be left at the en closure end on both sides for future shifting of Rack/Wall enclosures. T he loops of OFC should be neatly clamped on walls/pillars. 4. FERULING AND LABELLING I.
